cases.title: Task/clocks/maturity
cases.given: A registered exact task and listing calendar
cases.when: Freeze origin/cutoff/issue/maturity; count supplied calendars; delay publication without moving economic date
cases.then: Match horizon/calendar; cutoff leak and missed deadline abstain; no NAV/market mixing

cases.title: Targets/ground truth
cases.given: Positive wealth inputs plus declared action/FX revisions
cases.when: Compute each declared equation and append amended outcomes/scores

cases.title: PIT admission
cases.given: Source manifest, membership/exposures and publication evidence
cases.when: Attempt future macro, constituents, action-vintage or historical LLM insertion
cases.then: Exclude contaminated blocks or classify prospective_only; known_at field alone insufficient

cases.title: Modules/models
cases.when: Try NAV candle detector, future-confirmed extrema, immature analog, unknown fallback feature block
cases.then: Reject; F1-F8 retained; family count never treated as artifact count

cases.title: Leakage/search
cases.given: Dated all-asset folds and full label intervals
cases.when: Try random row split, full-dataset scaler, test-selected model or twenty-row gap for yearly label
cases.then: Reject; inner preprocessing and calibration respect purged chronological boundaries

cases.title: Scoring/evidence
cases.when: Compute proper scores, calibration, quantile coverage/width and block uncertainty; count all trials/abstentions
cases.then: No loss-only calibration claim, no independence multiplication, no yearly maturity after eight weeks

cases.title: Eligibility/promotion
cases.given: Candidate with scope-specific evidence and owner approval binding
cases.when: Tuner attempts live calibration/promotion; corrupt hash or revoked rights triggers only authorised safety pause
cases.then: Deny unauthorised changes; append pause; rollback only eligible approved artifact

cases.title: Scenarios
cases.when: Attempt scenario probability or score as12month forecast
cases.then: Reject invented probability; explicit conditional scenario and financial assumptions

cases.title: Analog causal admission
cases.given: A20session historical analog with origin ten sessions before current cutoff
cases.when: Attempt to include unknown full outcome
cases.then: Exclude regardless of nearest distance; show raw vs effective neighbour count

cases.title: All fits spend one project cap
cases.given: A92fit scalar campaign and attempt three quantile heads
cases.then: Count all learnedfits including R1linear/logit baselines; stop at96percampaign,192permonth and two campaigns acrossdev/prod; never multiply bysevenhorizons silently.

cases.title: Final holdout spent after tuning
cases.given: A final test was opened and candidate failed
cases.when: Change threshold or select model after viewing outcomes
cases.then: Register spent test and failure; obtain truly untouched/new mature test before new confirmatory claim

cases.title: No free evidence by abstention
cases.given: Model issues only on easy subgroup
cases.then: Reject incomplete report; baseline paired subset plus full-set coverage and subgroup failures required

cases.title: Seven-horizon retained issuance states
cases.then: Expose rules labelled heuristic, eligible transparent baseline if qualified, else in_practice/pending/unavailable by output; no invented probability or dropped horizon

cases.title: Rights fail closed
cases.given: History view permitted but training/Anthropic sharing unknown
cases.then: Block that use; source/display permission does not imply training/sharing

cases.title: Extraction does not prove predictive value
cases.given: Inspect AI source-faithful news extraction result
cases.when: Promote numerical model without matched prospective ablation
cases.then: Deny; extraction quality and predictive incremental value are separate

cases.title: Incomplete path cannot label MDD
cases.given: Terminal close known but interior valuation missing
cases.then: Return can mature if eligible; MDD/MAE outcome missing_path unless approved complete evidence; no interpolate safe path

cases.title: Calendar correction append only
cases.given: Calendar revision changes already-frozen session schedule
cases.then: Reject; append amendment/provenance and preserve original prediction maturity

mandatory_semantic_invariants: mature Outcome known_at>=economic_maturity_at and all required observations available
Prediction task versions/price basis/currency/benchmark equal Outcome task context
probabilities in[0,1]; quantile levels strictly increasing and predicted returns nondecreasing
no duplicate immutable record_id with changed content hash
promotion active requires exact unexpired owner approval and eligible scope
event thresholds and inclusivity match task version
all output types independently eligible; missing component not silently renormalised
Decimal schema must accept0.70 and-0.10 but reject NaN/Infinity/exponent/leading-zero malformed forms
Date-time instance validation must actively check formats, rejecting missing timezone/impossible dates; jsonschema FormatChecker may lack optional date-time handler
